issues.summary: The dotnet-tool docs implied a runtime-only host could install the tool, but `dotnet tool install`/`update` are SDK commands.
issues.fix: State that install/update require the .NET 10 SDK; running the installed tool needs only the .NET 10 runtime.
issues.resolution_note: install.md channel table, Option A '.NET prerequisites' block, and the shared prerequisite paragraph now distinguish SDK-to-install from runtime-to-run.
